result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero quantity. `StockOverviewTest` passes (4 tests, including a new one for this case). I did not commit.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findStockLevelsByWarehouse`, around line 2107): the query now adds `AND s.quantity > 0`, and its Javadoc no longer says it includes zero quantities. The only other caller is a demo printout in `DemoScenario`, so nothing else depends on the zero rows.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: added `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`. It takes all nuts out of WH-1, sets screws to 0, and checks that the list shows only "Bolt 10" while the quantity of nuts still answers 0.
